lines.speaker: Brixie
lines.text: The Great Brass Balance! Heavy side sinks, light side rises. My one-dot sandbag keeps the near pan down.

lines.speaker: Brixie
lines.text: The big three-dot weight up top drops if someone bonks the brick over the near pan. Three beats a sandbag and a hero, so whoever is standing on that pan goes up, up, up!
